world.text: Abu al-'Abbas celebrated the Abbasid victory over the Zanj Rebellion with a parade in Baghdad.
An expedition led by Francisco Javier de Balmis departed A Coruña, Spain, with the aim of vaccinating millions in South America and Asia against smallpox.
Flying Scotsman became the first steam locomotive officially to exceed 100 miles per hour (161 km/h).
World War II: Japanese warships defeated the U.S. Navy in a nighttime naval battle off Tassafaronga, Guadalcanal.
The Wall, a rock opera and concept album by the English band Pink Floyd, was first released.
